aboutText: Ocean Blue Builders has been shaping Melbourne's residential landscape for over 15 years, delivering bespoke homes and luxury renovations that stand the test of time. From Port Phillip bayside builds to inner-city townhouses, our team combines local knowledge with uncompromising quality to bring your vision to life.
